about: The decisions an importer of the old system follows, written by hand; each is a proposal until the mapping of its module is approved (master list T-181). "words": for every column of the old system whose words are listed and whose table moves, the place of each word in an enumeration of the admin ("places": old word, then the value of the enumeration), or why it has none ("without"). "unique": every unique index of the tables an importer writes to, with who gives the value ("admin": the admin makes it; "numbers": only numbers of other records; "key": the one class of T-177; "carried": the old system's value is written) and, for a carried value, the rule when two old values meet as the database compares them ("stop": the import stops and names both; "first": the one with the lower old number is kept, the other is listed). "lines": where one old row makes several records in one table of the admin (the lines of a quotation), those records get no entry in the table of the old numbers: the entry of their parent answers for them (T-177). Read by App\Domain\System\Import\OldSystem\Rules; checked against the old schema and written into document 36 by scripts/verify-old-shape.mjs; checked against the admin's enumerations and against the database's own indexes by the admin's tests.

without.status_change: The admin keeps three kinds for this: a change of stage, an event of a quotation, an event of an invoice. Which one depends on what the entry is about, not on the word.
without.document: The admin's timeline has no kind for "a document was attached".

invoices.status.note: The old system works "Overdue" out when it shows an invoice and never stores it; so does the admin.

meetings.channel.note: A meeting becomes a task and an entry on the timeline. That it was held by video is kept in the note, not in the kind.

without.no_show: A task of the admin is open, done or cancelled. A meeting nobody came to is none of the three.

without.system: A message of the admin comes in or goes out. A line the system wrote itself is neither: in the admin it is a note inside the conversation.

without.Production: The admin's stages are those of a fit-out: design, execution, finishing. The making of furniture has no stage of its own there.
without.Delivery: The admin has no stage for the delivery.
without.Installation: The admin has no stage for the installation.

without.Review: The admin has one step before a quotation is sent (waiting for approval); the old system has two, and this is the first of them.
without.Revised: In the old system a quotation that is changed after it was sent stays one record with this status. In the admin the change is a new revision, and the earlier one is marked as replaced.
without.Approved: The same word, another meaning. In the old system it is the last step: the customer agreed. In the admin "approved" is a step inside the company, before the quotation is sent. It must not be matched by its name.

without.matched: The admin does not compare a bill with its purchase order and its goods receipt, so it keeps no result of that comparison.
without.tolerance: The admin does not compare a bill with its purchase order and its goods receipt, so it keeps no result of that comparison.
without.variance: The admin does not compare a bill with its purchase order and its goods receipt, so it keeps no result of that comparison.
without.unlinked: The admin does not compare a bill with its purchase order and its goods receipt, so it keeps no result of that comparison.

supplier_invoices.status.note: The admin works "part paid" out from what was paid; the old system has no such word.

lines.why: The lines of an invoice are one block inside the old row and rows of their own in the admin. They are written with their invoice and replaced with it; the entry of the invoice answers for them.
The lines of a quotation are one block inside the old row and rows of their own in the admin. They are written with their quotation and replaced with it; the entry of the quotation answers for them.
